description: This file implements a matrix plugin configuration and migration management module, including functions for normalizing legacy config, detecting issues, formatting reports, and executing repair sequences for the Matrix plugin within the openclaw project.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a Record<string, unknown>.

methods.name: hasLegacyMatrixRoomAllowAlias
methods.description: Checks if a value is a record with a boolean 'allow' property.

methods.name: hasLegacyMatrixRoomMapAllowAliases
methods.description: Checks if any rooms in a record have 'allow' set to boolean.

methods.name: hasLegacyMatrixAccountRoomAllowAliases
methods.description: Checks if any account's groups or rooms have legacy 'allow' properties.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixRoomAllowAliases
methods.description: Converts 'allow' properties to 'enabled' in room records, tracking changes.

methods.name: normalizeMatrixCompatibilityConfig
methods.description: Normalizes legacy 'allow' config to 'enabled' in channels.matrix, including nested accounts.

methods.name: hasConfiguredMatrixChannel
methods.description: Detects if the configuration has a matrix channel setup.

methods.name: hasConfiguredMatrixPluginSurface
methods.description: Detects if the matrix plugin is configured via installs, entries, or environment variables.

methods.name: hasConfiguredMatrixEnv
methods.description: Checks environment variables for matrix-related configuration.

methods.name: configMayNeedMatrixDoctorSequence
methods.description: Determines if a matrix doctor sequence might be needed based on config or environment.

methods.name: formatMatrixLegacyStatePreview
methods.description: Formats a report string for legacy matrix state detection.

methods.name: formatMatrixLegacyCryptoPreview
methods.description: Formats warnings and plans for legacy crypto state detection.

methods.name: collectMatrixInstallPathWarnings
methods.description: Detects and formats warnings related to plugin install paths.

methods.name: cleanStaleMatrixPluginConfig
methods.description: Removes stale matrix plugin references if the install path is missing.

methods.name: applyMatrixDoctorRepair
methods.description: Performs repair actions for legacy matrix state and crypto, with snapshot management.

methods.name: runMatrixDoctorSequence
methods.description: Runs the full matrix doctor sequence, including detection, repair, and reporting.
